title: Study to Evaluate the Safety of Subcutaneous Alemtuzumab in Patients With B-Cell Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
brief_summary: This is a Phase II trial to study the safety and tolerability of subcutaneous alemtuzumab administered without dose escalation to patients with advanced B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (B-CLL).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* B-CLL that has failed fludarabine

Exclusion Criteria:

* Performance status grade 3
